title: Shared parts of an item
description: The fields every kind of item shares, the condition on a retired item and the patterns of the identifiers. The schemas of the kinds reference these definitions; this file describes no item file by itself.

name.description: A speaking name: lowercase words joined by hyphens. It may change; only the identifier counts.

status.description: planned: published and citable, binds nobody until a pull request makes it active. active: in force. retired: the file stays.

retired.description: A retired item names its reason. reason and replaced-by stand only on a retired item.

rule-id.description: The identifier of a rule: R and three digits from 001, a fourth digit only after 999.

definition-id.description: The identifier of a definition: D and three digits from 001, a fourth digit only after 999.

principle-id.description: The identifier of a principle: P and three digits from 001, a fourth digit only after 999.

group-id.description: The identifier of a group: G and three digits from 001, a fourth digit only after 999.
